LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.0.label: Close Swordplay
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.0.descripti: Retains original damage within 3 cells, life steal and melee cooldown. Later offensive nodes require actual ordinary hits within 3 cells. Distant hits neither charge nor redeem them; weapon type is unrestricted. Progression stays with the item.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.1.label: Relentless Pressure
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.1.descripti: Three consecutive ordinary hits on the same enemy within 3 cells, no more than 3 seconds between eligible hits, deal 75 bonus damage, once per 8 seconds. An eligible hit on another enemy resets the count. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.2.label: Answering Blade
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.2.descripti: After taking actual enemy damage, mark that attacker for 4 seconds. A later ordinary hit on that enemy within 3 cells consumes the mark for 50 bonus damage. One mark maximum, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Fully prevented damage creates no mark. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.3.label: Measured Breath
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.3.descripti: After Relentless Pressure deals actual bonus damage, heal 20 base points of your recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Permanent scars and missing parts are not restored. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.4.label: Pressing Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.4.descripti: After Relentless Pressure deals actual bonus damage, shield yourself for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Prevented bonus damage grants no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.5.label: Rescuing Blade
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.5.descripti: After Answering Blade deals actual bonus damage, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Never substitutes you when no ally is eligible. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.6.label: Returning Sweep
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Duelist.nodes.6.descripti: After Answering Blade deals actual bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 2 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. Never substitutes the original target. Base rewards: damage 25.
